contentText: In tonight's edition, Nigerians are feeling the consequences of the war in the Middle East at the pump, with gas prices soaring. Also, the Democratic Republic of Congo's armed forces begin a disarmament push against the FDLR, a militia linked to the Rwandan genocide in 1994. And in South Africa,  a mine owner has reached an understanding with illegal miners, allowing them limited access to his property once formal operations end for the day.
